fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at 23ada88d with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), RHIZA_* env cleared, read-only against the real root ~/code (nebari, rhiza, live root daemon). rhiza health at the root: machine parts once (daemon running, 2 live runs, matching daemon status at the root; usage read from the root daemon home nebari), then main/inbox/requests/roadmap/check parts tagged nebari: and rhiza:, project field set in --json. --project nebari and --project rhiza give that project only, with the daemon part still counting 2 live runs; --project nope exits 2 with not registered. The cycle-1 major (daemon part counting only the first project) is fixed. Scoped testscripts health-projects, daemon-status-projects, inbox-projects, roadmap-projects, describe-golden pass.

QA cycle 2 at 23ada88d with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), RHIZA_* env cleared. On the real root ~/code, rhiza inbox --json lists rhiza and nebari failed runs each with its project field (text shows project: lines); --project nebari lists only nebari items. In a scratch root (HOME and git config scratch) with rhiza.toml registering alpha holding a question run: at the plain root the question is listed tagged alpha; after git init + rhiza init of the root itself, rhiza inbox lists the root own empty inbox, --all lists alpha question, --project alpha lists it. The cycle-1 major (own-model root merged every project) is fixed. inbox-projects testscript passes.

QA cycle 2 at 23ada88d with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), RHIZA_* env cleared. On the real root ~/code, rhiza roadmap shows groups headed rhiza: milestone-29, rhiza: Backlog, rhiza: areas, each --json group carrying project rhiza; --project nebari gives no groups (nebari has no milestones or change sets, as health reports). roadmap-projects testscript passes.

QA cycle 2 at 23ada88d with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), RHIZA_* env cleared. On the real root ~/code, rhiza daemon status --json: root daemon once (running), projects parts nebari (0 runs, last_started) and rhiza (2 live runs of this milestone, 12 skips with reasons: umbrella, usage reserve), skipped_projects empty. Text shows Project nebari:/Project rhiza: sections with live runs, last started/resumed and Skipped lines. daemon-status-projects testscript (now asserting each project live run and skip under its name) passes.
